column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 to SLSA (Supply-chain Levels for Software Artefacts) Mappings

# mapping_set_description: Mappings between ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS supplier-relationship and secure-development controls (Annex A 5.19-5.23, 8.25-8.31) and SLSA framework concepts (BuildLevel, BuildProvenance, ResourceDescriptor). VALUE.md identifies SLSA as the targeted alignment for the named supply-chain risk gap. Predicates - skos:closeMatch where SLSA provides a structured representation of an Annex A objective; skos:relatedMatch where SLSA constructs partially satisfy an Annex A control.
